scope: Proposition 3.10 (Conditional comparison error) of the manuscript “The low-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick fluctuation scale” (preprints/The-low-temperature-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-fluctuation-scale-September-24-2026/The-low-temperature-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-fluctuation-scale-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 217 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e0e2e5e34169e701), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 27. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let λ ≥ n−10 and A = Aλ = nδ√ nE/ √ λ. If A = o(1), assume that a minimizer has a regular outer region above A. Then its integral (7) is at most n10δE for all sufficiently large n. If A stays bounded below by a positive constant, the same conclusion holds without a regularity hypothesis. Consequently, if these hypotheses hold along an admissible sweep from zero to any strength at most d2, then 0 ≤ Mλ − fn(b0, h0) ≤ n20δE. The fixed-strength assertions apply also to the wall variant, whereas this last conclusion requires an admissible sweep.
